verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public REST API with key-based auth, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and a versioned changelog. The changelog shows endpoints across incidents, status-page events, alert sources and meeting recordings, and an MCP server generated from the OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates that every UI capability (e.g., workflow building, retrospective editing, AI SRE configuration) is reachable via the API. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence of API coverage for workflows/retrospectives/AI settings, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Rootly API allows you to create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, internal services, or any external automation system.
Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
